source.snippet: I am building certain CI/CD process based upon if staging environment has released or beta package version. I need a way to quickly find out if installed package version is released or not. This would be inefficient to check the released package version list against the installed package version id. — Salesforce Stack Exchange, captured 2026-07-23.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers building CI/CD pipelines cannot efficiently determine at runtime whether an installed managed package version is released or beta, forcing slow workarounds against the Tooling API. This blocks reliable automated deployment gating.
target_segment: Salesforce ISV developers and DevOps engineers at companies with managed package CI/CD pipelines (2GP/2GMP).
notes: Professional CI/CD context — company-grade workflow blocker. Buyer is a Salesforce developer/team already investing in CI/CD infrastructure. Opportunity: a lightweight API wrapper or CLI tool that abstracts package-version release-state checks, potentially bundled into a broader Salesforce DevOps utility. Single question but reflects a recurring pain pattern in Salesforce DevOps community.
